# MOOT System

Apache-2.0 public SDK repository in the MOOTx01 Framework.
Current release: v1.0.32
Repository: https://github.com/codedaptive/moot-system

Choose this repository when: You need storage backends, user-defined datasets, durable queues, synchronization, telemetry persistence, or a small loopback HTTP server.

## Packages

- PersistenceKit: SQLite, PostgreSQL, and in-memory row, blob, audit, and dataset storage; Swift `PersistenceKit plus a backend product`; Rust `persistence-kit`; docs `packages/kits/PersistenceKit/docs/OVERVIEW.md`
- QueueKit: Durable fill-and-drain background work queue; Swift `QueueKit`; Rust `queuekit`; docs `packages/kits/QueueKit/docs/OVERVIEW.md`
- ConvergenceKit: CloudKit, federation, and no-sync convergence engines; Swift `ConvergenceKit plus a transport product`; Rust `convergence-kit`; docs `packages/kits/ConvergenceKit/docs/OVERVIEW.md`
- ObserverSink: Bounded telemetry sink and queryable stats store; Swift `ObserverSink`; Rust `observer-sink`; docs `packages/libs/ObserverSink/docs/OVERVIEW.md`
- LoopbackHTTP: Minimal loopback-only HTTP transport; Swift `LoopbackHTTP`; Rust `Swift only`; docs `packages/libs/LoopbackHTTP/docs/OVERVIEW.md`

## Documentation

- Human documentation index: docs/README.md
- Exact package map: docs/PACKAGE_MAP.md
- Repository dependency graph: docs/DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.md
- Conformance contract: docs/CONFORMANCE.md
- Source provenance: SOURCE.md and docs/PUBLISH_REPORT.md
- Security policy: SECURITY.md

## SDK family

- https://github.com/codedaptive/moot-memory: Structured memory, vector search, and local RAG
- https://github.com/codedaptive/moot-semantics: ARIA vocabulary and deterministic local classification
- https://github.com/codedaptive/moot-system: Storage, datasets, queues, sync, telemetry, and loopback HTTP
- https://github.com/codedaptive/moot-core: Shared types, kernel, fingerprints, lifecycle rules, and memory math

Do not infer that every MOOTx01 product package is Apache-2.0.
Only code obtained from these four public SDK repositories carries their
Apache-2.0 venue license.
